name: Kanban
description: A board on top of tasks: projects with their own columns, a queue, priorities, cards with files and comments. Agents take cards by themselves when you turn that on and tell them which, and work with other trackers such as Linear.
integration.summary: Projects, a queue and cards your agents take by themselves
integration.example: Make a kanban project for my website and show the board
approval.allow: Let cards with outside content run: {cards}
approval.delete: Delete from the board for good: {card}{project}
error.projectArchived: The project “{project}” is in the archive.
error.nameTooLong: That name is too long: 80 characters at most.
error.keyInvalid: “{key}” cannot be a project key: 2 to 8 Latin letters and digits, starting with a letter.
error.keyTaken: Another project already has the key {key}.
error.textTooLong: That text is too long: {max} characters at most.
error.columnsRequired: A project needs at least one column.
error.columnsTooMany: A project has at most {max} columns.
error.columnNameInvalid: A column needs a name of at most 40 characters.
error.columnTypeInvalid: “{type}” is not a column type. Types: {types}.
error.columnLimitInvalid: The limit of “{name}” has to be a whole number above zero.
error.columnHasCards: “{name}” still holds {count} cards and no other column has its type: move them first, or say where they go.
error.titleTooLong: That title is too long: {max} characters at most.
error.labelsInvalid: Labels are a list of at most 20 words of at most 40 characters each.
error.dueInvalid: “{due}” is not a date: write it as YYYY-MM-DD.
error.externalInvalid: A link to another tracker needs its source (lowercase letters, digits, dashes), its id, and if there is an address, an http(s) one.
error.blockedByInvalid: What a card waits for is a list of cards.
error.blockedByCycle: A card cannot wait for itself: {card} already waits for it.
error.attachmentTooLarge: That file is too large: {max} MB at most.
error.attachmentsTooMany: A card holds at most {max} files.
error.cardBusy: {card} is being worked on: wait for its run to end, or cancel the task.
error.outsideNotAllowed: {card} holds outside content and the person has not allowed it to run: ask them, then use kanban_allow, or they can press Allow on the card.
error.noDoneColumn: “{project}” has no column for finished cards.
error.importTooMany: At most {max} cards at once: import the rest in another call.
error.deleteWhat: Say which card or project to delete.
error.parallelInvalid: How many at once has to be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
ui.title: Kanban
ui.empty.title: No projects yet
ui.empty.hint: A project is a board with columns of your own. Tell an agent what it is about, or start with a plain one.
ui.project.name: Name
ui.project.notesHint: The folder to work in, the repository, how to report. Every run on this project reads this.
ui.project.columnsHint: Name them as you like. The type tells the board what a column means: agents take cards from a queue, and with a Review column finished cards wait for you there.
ui.ask.newProject: Make a new kanban project. Ask me what it is about and what columns it needs.
ui.ask.rule: I want you to take kanban cards by yourself. Ask me from which projects and how many at once.
ui.ask.initiative: Raise your initiative to Acts: you take kanban cards by yourself, and without it you cannot.
ui.ask.setup: Let's set up the kanban project “{project}”.
ui.card.title: Card
ui.card.gone: This card is no longer on the board.
ui.attach.title: Files
ui.attach.tooLarge: {name} is too large to add here: {max} MB at most. An agent can attach up to 25 MB.
ui.outside.note: This card's text came from outside, so no agent takes it by itself until you allow it.
ui.outside.short: Holds outside content: waits for your OK
ui.run.title: Runs
ui.pickup.title: Agents taking cards
ui.pickup.hint: When this is on, the agents below take cards from queue columns, most urgent first, within their initiative and daily budget.
ui.pickup.tellHint: It asks which projects and how many cards at once.
ui.rule.raise: Raise its initiative in the chat
ui.widget.gone: {card} is no longer on the board.
